# iosxr_multicast_routing_vrf (Data Source)

This data source can read the Multicast Routing VRF configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxr_multicast_routing_vrf" "example" {
  vrf_name = "VRF1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

- `vrf_name` (String) VRF configs
